title: Hashing for Integrity, Passwords and Data Lookup
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

questions.prompt: How does hybrid encryption usually protect bulk web traffic?
questions.answer: Use asymmetric establishment/authentication then symmetric traffic keys.

questions.prompt: In Big O notation, what is binary search worst-case complexity?
questions.answer: O(log n) for sorted random-access data.
options: O(log n) for sorted random-access data.
O(log n) for unsorted random-access data.
There is not enough information to determine the result.
questions.feedback: Model answer: O(log n) for sorted random-access data.

questions.prompt: When does a linear search stop?
questions.answer: On a match or after examining all items.
options: On a match or before examining all items.
On a match AND after examining all items.
On a match or after examining all items.
questions.feedback: Model answer: On a match or after examining all items.
